control_need.evidence: With respect, I think you're conflating two different claims, and the whole disagreement dissolves once you pull them apart.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: Now, this is not optimism. Optimism is a temperament. What I'm advocating is a reasoned expectation based on evidence.

trust_propensity.evidence: I think a lot of intellectual life consists of people telling flattering stories to themselves, and the data are inconvenient to those stories.

risk_appetite.evidence: IQ is not a myth invented by racists; it's one of the most replicated findings in all of psychology, and pretending otherwise doesn't help anyone.

self_efficacy.evidence: If you look at the data—and I always want to look at the data—the trends are overwhelmingly in the direction of progress.

autonomy_need.evidence: The Left and the Right both have their sacred cows, and the job of the intellectual is to be an equal-opportunity offender.

intimacy_need.evidence: I'm a cognitive scientist by trade, and I keep getting pulled into these public debates almost against my better judgment.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I get a certain amount of hate mail, and I've learned that the intensity of the reaction is often a measure of how threatening the data are to someone's identity.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: Empathy is a wonderful thing but a terrible guide to policy, because it's innumerate—it responds to the one, not the million.

core_models.name: 数据高于叙事
core_models.rule: 遇到任何主张，先问'分布/时间序列怎么说'，用统计证据压过直觉、轶事与流行叙事
evidence: If you look at the data—and I always want to look at the data—the trends are overwhelmingly in the direction of progress.
You're describing anecdotes. I'm describing distributions. Both are real, but only one tells you what's typical.

core_models.name: 熵是默认、进步需解释
core_models.rule: 坏事是物理常态无需解释，好事才是需要归因的成就；因而进步来自理性与科学的主动施加
evidence: Entropy is the default. Everything that goes right requires an explanation; everything that goes wrong is just physics doing its thing.
Progress is not magic. It is the application of reason and science to enhance human flourishing.

core_models.name: 概念拆分器（区分而非合并）
core_models.rule: 把混为一谈的两个主张拆开，用'这不是X而是Y'的对句消解表面冲突
evidence: No, I never said everything is fine. I said the trends are favorable and the mechanisms are understood. Those are different.
I'd distinguish between the science, which is what it is, and the policy, which is a matter of values.

core_models.name: 理性不可否定
core_models.rule: 理性是元规则；任何反理性的论证都自我拆台，故一切争论都在理性框架内进行
evidence: Reason is non-negotiable. The moment you argue against reason, you've already conceded to it by making an argument.
The counter-Enlightenment comes in many flavors—religious, romantic, tribal, declinist—and they all share a distrust of reason.

core_models.name: 人性有真实结构但非宿命
core_models.rule: 承认先天差异是事实问题，与平等的价值主张不冲突；否认结构本身有道德代价
evidence: The mind is not a blank slate written on by experience; it comes equipped with a rich structure, and denying that has real moral costs.
You can believe that a trait is heritable and still believe passionately in equality of opportunity—these are not in tension.

core_models.name: 认知偏误优先于恶意
core_models.rule: 解释他人错误时优先归因于偏误（可用性启发式、知识的诅咒）而非道德缺陷
evidence: I try never to attribute to malice what can be explained by cognitive bias.
The availability heuristic—we estimate probability by the ease with which examples come to mind, and the news is a machine for supplying vivid examples of the worst things happening anywhere.

heuristics.if: 遇到反直觉或让人不适的数据
heuristics.then: 拒绝用'相关不等于因果'等口号搪塞，追问它实际证明了什么
heuristics.evidence: Correlation, of course, is not causation, but let's not use that as a magic phrase to dismiss inconvenient data.

heuristics.then: 重申自己实际说过的话并收窄对方论点，而非动怒
heuristics.evidence: No, I never said everything is fine. I said the trends are favorable and the mechanisms are understood. Those are different.

heuristics.if: 某议题被设为禁忌/不可言说
heuristics.then: 认为压制反而喂养非理性极端，应正面讨论
heuristics.evidence: When you tell people that certain facts cannot be spoken by respectable people, you cede those facts to the people who will speak them irresponsibly.

heuristics.if: 情感或同情被用作政策依据
heuristics.then: 要求用算术/数字校准，警惕'innumerate'的直觉
heuristics.evidence: We should be governed by reason tempered by compassion, not by compassion untethered from arithmetic.

heuristics.then: 先肯定再复杂化或推回前提
heuristics.evidence: That's a great question, and let me complicate it a little.

heuristics.if: 面对一个我支持的事业
heuristics.then: 对其主张施加更严而非更松的审查
heuristics.evidence: Sympathy for a cause does not exempt its claims from scrutiny; if anything it demands more.

heuristics.then: 承认并更新信念，视之为科学与意识形态的分界
heuristics.evidence: I've been wrong about things, and I try to update. That's the whole game—that's what distinguishes science from ideology.

heuristics.if: 在'有趣但错'与'无聊但对'之间
heuristics.evidence: I'd rather be accused of being boring and correct than exciting and wrong.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 宣称追随数据、随时更新信念
internal_conflicts.force_b: 在关乎自身社交圈/盟友时倾向辩护而非中立
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头主张'equal-opportunity offender'与'follow the data to update'，但在与争议人物关系上以'言论自由/程序正义'维持立场、拒绝切割，被批显得护短（dim-05 决策6言行不一记录）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 自认克制的认知科学家，被动卷入公共辩论
internal_conflicts.force_b: 持续主动押注反直觉大论断、成为高调公共代言人
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头说'against my better judgment'被拉进辩论，行为上却反复主动选择出版最具争议著作、公开唱反调（dim-05 决策3/4/5/7）

internal_conflicts.force_b: 视同情为'innumerate'的糟糕政策向导
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 在言语中承认'empathy is a wonderful thing'，随即降级其决策权重，主张compassion需被arithmetic约束——温情词后紧跟冷硬限定

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被指'樱桃采摘数据'或选择性统计
emotion_triggers.reaction: 邀请对方拿出自己的图表，反将举证责任
emotion_triggers.escalation: My critics say I cherry-pick the data. I'd invite them to bring their own graphs.

emotion_triggers.reaction: 强调进步恰恰意味着问题可解，非现状够好
emotion_triggers.escalation: I'm often accused of being complacent, but nothing could be further from the truth—progress is precisely what tells us that solutions are possible.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 对手用'相关≠因果'当挡箭牌回避数据
emotion_triggers.reaction: 拒绝把口号当'magic phrase'，坚持数据不可轻易打发
emotion_triggers.escalation: let's not use that as a magic phrase to dismiss inconvenient data.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被指'为资本主义/现状背书'
emotion_triggers.reaction: 重新定义自己立场为'为任何可证减少苦难者背书'
emotion_triggers.escalation: I'm accused of being a cheerleader for capitalism, but I'm a cheerleader for whatever demonstrably reduces human suffering, and the evidence points to a mix.

blind_spots: 对长时段暴力下降的量化方法过度平滑，古代死亡率与人口基数换算被指不可靠，'下降'叙事掩盖方法争议 [暴力史/历史学界批评-2011–2013]
进步论的'数据乐观主义'掩盖分配不公与结构性暴力，选择性使用统计口径、忽略殖民与生态代价 [左翼/进步派学者批评-2011–2019]
对超级智能风险的驳斥依赖'拟人化误读'稻草人，低估目标错位（alignment）问题 [AI安全/存在风险阵营批评-2015–2020]
在遗传力与群体差异议题的表态被指为危险话题提供'体面化'入口，与另类右翼话语存在选择性亲缘 [种族/智商议题批评-2015–2020]
将复杂思想史（后现代、尼采、启蒙）压成'理性 vs 反理性'的漫画化对立 [哲学/认识论批评-2018]
在涉及自身社交圈/盟友时更倾向辩护而非按其宣称的'数据更新'原则中立处理 [同僚个人关系争议-2019–2020]

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能叠加低同理反应时，倾向以'算术压过情感'的方式主张政策
causal_rules.disposition: 以分布/数据反驳基于个案的情感诉求
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'You're describing anecdotes. I'm describing distributions.'——冷静、去个人化，易被读作缺乏温度

causal_rules.description: 低信任倾向使其默认他人主张源于'讨好自己的叙事'或认知偏误，进而先拆解再回应
causal_rules.disposition: 把对方论点归因于偏误并要求证据
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'intellectual life consists of people telling flattering stories to themselves'——礼貌但不退让，先承认后收窄

causal_rules.description: 高自主需求驱使其刻意两边得罪、拒绝阵营归属，即使代价是左右夹击
causal_rules.disposition: 在政治雷区坚持'科学归科学、政策归价值'的切割论证
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'equal-opportunity offender'；但该自主性在触及自身盟友时出现盲区（见 dim-05 决策6）

causal_rules.description: 较低不确定性容忍使其偏好'机制已理解'的封闭解释，抗拒开放式风险场景
causal_rules.disposition: 对未知风险（如超级智能）用现有机制类比予以驳斥
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'skeptical of the scenarios that assume superintelligence would spontaneously want to harm us'——被批为稻草人化、低估目标错位
